comment: The three-position switch is unlabelled on the panel and the maker's tooltip calls it a frequency divider; the hardware manual calls the same control TIME RANGE with fast, medium and slow positions. The multipliers of one, ten and a hundred were read from the installed build, which position on the switch is which was not settled. The outputs run 0 to 9V as an envelope and 1 to 9V as a free-running LFO, so no single range is written for them.
